body: Trend lens dito: huwag nating gawing ‘rising epidemic’ ang isang fresh warning kung wala pang time-series evidence. What IS actionable already is the mechanism: previous victims are being retargeted with recovery narratives, and the official warning confirms that pattern exists. To call it accelerating, gusto ko ng complaint counts over time, repeat-victim share, at channel breakdown. One warning = signal; several periods moving together = trend. Crystal ball stays in the drawer muna.
